meaning: Share of a turbine's or wind farm's rated capacity actually generated over a period (0 to 1, or expressed as a percentage).
formula: Average powerMw divided by ratedMw (join telemetry to turbines on turbine). Compare against sites.targetCf to see over/under-performance.
q: select cf:avg powerMw%ratedMw, avgPowerMw:avg powerMw, avgWindMs:avg windMs by site from (select turbine,site,powerMw,windMs from telemetry where date=2026.10.08) lj select ratedMw:first ratedMw by turbine from turbines
caveat: Join telemetry to turbines for ratedMw; compare against targetCf from sites.

meaning: Number of faults per turbine (or per turbine-day) by manufacturer, site, or wind regime.
formula: Count of faults divided by number of turbines in that group. Always check wind regime (calm vs gale >= 14 m/s) before ranking manufacturers — raw fault rates can reflect site exposure rather than hardware reliability.
q: select faults:count faultCode, downtimeHr:sum downtimeMin%60f by manufacturer from (select turbine,faultCode,downtimeMin from faults where date within 2026.10.01 2026.10.10) lj select manufacturer:first manufacturer by turbine from turbines
caveat: Raw manufacturer fault rates are confounded by offshore gale exposure (fair_reliability_comparison).

meaning: Like-for-like reliability comparison across turbine manufacturers, controlling for wind regime (calm < 14 m/s vs gale >= 14 m/s).
formula: Bucket each turbine-day (or fault) into calm (windMs < 14) vs gale (windMs >= 14), compute faults per turbine-day within each regime per manufacturer, and compare within each regime rather than raw totals.
q: select faults:count faultCode by manufacturer,regime from (select turbine,faultCode,regime:?[windMs>=14;`gale;`calm] from aj[`turbine`time; select time,turbine,faultCode from faults where date within 2026.10.01 2026.10.10; select time,turbine,windMs from telemetry where date within 2026.10.01 2026.10.10]) lj select manufacturer:first manufacturer by turbine from turbines
caveat: Manufacturers deployed heavily offshore experience far more gale hours; always compare within calm and gale regimes separately.

meaning: Sensor readings (gearboxTempC, vibrationMmS, windMs, powerMw) prevailing at or just before each fault timestamp.
formula: As-of join faults to telemetry on turbine and time (or time minus a lookback like 0D00:10 for early-warning precursors).
q: select time,turbine,site,faultCode,severity,gearboxTempC,vibrationMmS,windMs,powerMw from aj[`turbine`time; select time,turbine,site,faultCode,severity from faults where date=2026.10.08,severity=`critical; select time,turbine,gearboxTempC,vibrationMmS,windMs,powerMw from telemetry where date=2026.10.08]
caveat: Sort or keep telemetry keyed on turbine,time; shift fault time back (time-0D00:10) to inspect pre-fault precursors.

meaning: Relationship between wind speed (windMs) and power output (powerMw) for a turbine or site, used to spot underperforming assets.
formula: Average powerMw grouped by 1 m/s wind speed bins (floor windMs) or scatter of windMs vs powerMw.
q: select avgPowerMw:avg powerMw, n:count turbine by windBin:`long$floor windMs from telemetry where date=2026.10.07,turbine=`T07
caveat: Compare a suspect turbine against peer turbines of the same ratedMw at the same site.
